summary: Qnity Electronics filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing that DuPont, Chemours and Corteva entered a Settlement Agreement with North Carolina and certain municipalities resolving PFAS and other emissions claims from the Fayetteville Works facility plus unrelated state PFAS claims. Qnity carries a $43 million indemnification liability, 44% of DuPont's after-tax liability, unchanged from Q2 2026. Settlements count against the 2021 MOU limit at net present value over 25 years at an 8% discount; future escrow contributions deemed satisfied. Watch residual PFAS indemnity exposure and MOU cap.
